title: Restriction of a Boolean sequence
statement: Let $\tau:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and let $M,i,k\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i+k\le M$. The length-$k$ prefix of the list $(\tau(0),\ldots,\tau(M-1))$ after deleting its first $i$ entries is the list $(\tau(i),\ldots,\tau(i+k-1))$.
